description: React component for selecting emoji skin tones in Mattermost's emoji picker, including UI logic and internationalization.

classes.name: EmojiPickerSkin
classes.description: React component for emoji skin tone selection with UI state management and internationalization.

methods.name: ariaLabel
methods.description: Generates accessible label for skin tone button based on selected skin tone.

methods.name: hideSkinTonePicker
methods.description: Closes the skin tone picker and triggers callback if skin tone changed.

methods.name: handleSkinToneHidden
methods.description: Handles transition end when skin tone picker is hidden.

methods.name: skinTonePickerButton
methods.description: Renders the button to toggle skin tone picker, with icon and tooltip.

methods.name: choices
methods.description: Renders list of skin tone options as buttons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire skin tone picker UI with transition effects.
